verdict.rationale: The only evidence is a documentation entry titled "Nitrokey Provisioning for Entra ID". It suggests a first-party organizational provisioning (pre-registration) workflow, but the pack gives no details on scope or scale. The nitropy CLI could be scripted for bulk setup, but that is a developer building block and earns no credit. missing for 10: documented bulk/batch configuration of many keys, lifecycle tracking or inventory of issued keys, details of the Entra ID provisioning flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of fleet-scale use.

support.subject: As an IT admin, I can provision keys across an organization at scale — pre-registration, bulk configuration, and lifecycle tracking of issued keys
